description: Choose the language of the interface. Applying reloads resources and rebuilds Settings Center captions.
label: Interface language

description: Choose the built-in help language independently of the interface language.
label: Help language

description: Allow local language files to override bundled interface and help translations.
label: Use local translations

description: Select the application palette. Preview is reversible until Apply. Existing custom palette overrides are preserved on Cancel.
label: Color theme

description: Adjust insufficient foreground and background contrast in supported palette and file-highlight colors. Box slots are excluded from the global correction pass.
label: Correct low contrast

description: Use the platform monospace font on supported Windows and macOS graphical frontends instead of the custom font.
label: Use system monospace font

description: Choose a font for supported graphical frontends. A custom font can be entered manually.
label: Graphical font

description: Set graphical font size. This does not change the font of an external terminal emulator.
label: Font size

description: Keep the main menu bar visible instead of showing it only when activated.
label: Always show menu bar

description: Format the host title with %State, %Ver, %Platform, %Backend, %Host, %User and %Admin.
label: Window title template

description: Show the complete file identity in editor and viewer title bars instead of only the basename.
label: Full file paths in titles

description: Choose how plain f4 launches. Explicit --gui or --tty arguments override this default for that launch.
label: Startup mode

description: Default graphical renderer. Automatic uses startup detection. Command-line choices override this value; unknown external renderer IDs are preserved.
label: Graphical renderer

description: Default terminal renderer. Command-line renderer choices override this preference.
label: Terminal renderer

description: Show tabs always, only with multiple workspaces, while Ctrl is held, or never.
label: Show workspace tabs

description: Draw workspace tabs over the content instead of reserving a layout row.
label: Overlay workspace tabs

description: Keep numbers permanently, keep them during this session, or renumber to match the current tab order.
label: Workspace numbering

description: Open the workspace chooser with Ctrl+Tab instead of switching directly.
label: Ctrl+Tab opens chooser

description: Reserve Alt+number shortcuts for workspace selection.
label: Alt+number switches tabs

description: Recreate saved workspaces at startup instead of restoring only the initial workspace.
label: Restore workspace tabs

description: Save panel folders and focused files. Turning this off omits these values from subsequently saved workspace sessions.
label: Save and restore panel paths

description: Automatically persist configuration and dialog-related changes. Explicit Apply still saves when this is off.
label: Save preferences automatically

description: Remember panel view modes, sorting, visibility, active workspace and workspace layout.
label: Save panel layout automatically

description: Remember locations and focused files for both sides of saved workspaces. Save and restore panel paths must also be enabled.
label: Save panel locations automatically

description: Remember supported graphical-window dimensions and position, not external terminal geometry.
label: Save graphical window automatically

description: Include hidden files and folders in the listing. The parent-directory entry remains visible.
label: Show hidden files

description: Prefix folder names with a slash, unless a highlight rule already supplies one.
label: Prefix folder names

description: Show markers from matching file-highlight rules. Also affects path suggestions; symlinks retain their fallback arrow.
label: Show highlight marks

description: Align the final extension separately in the name column. Excludes folders, extensionless names and leading dots alone.
label: Separate filename extensions

description: Reserve a bottom row for the focused name, size and modification time. Short panels suppress this row.
label: Focused-file status row

description: Hide the scrollbar, show a minimal one, or show the full scrollbar with arrows.
label: Panel scrollbar

description: Replace the listing only when all directory results are ready and bypass cached previews. Off permits incremental results. It does not block all UI work.
label: Wait for complete directory listing

description: Include locally collected CPU and GPU sections when the information provider does not supply authoritative information.
label: Show CPU and GPU information

description: Display raw bytes instead of human-readable sizes in information and quick-view panels.
label: Show sizes in bytes

description: Classic types into the command line. Vim adds j/k and double dd/cc/mm actions. Search-first separates filename-search and command focus.
label: Panel navigation

description: In Search-first mode, keep command entry focused after executing a command rather than returning to the panel.
label: Keep command input focused

description: Enable filesystem path suggestions in the command line and path-enabled dialog fields.
label: Enable filesystem suggestions

description: Show completion while typing in fields with history or path suggestions. Does not add sources to arbitrary fields.
label: Show dialog completion dropdowns

description: Display complete paths rather than only the final filename or folder component.
label: Show full suggestion paths

description: Resolve suggestions from the active panel, passive panel, or both. Both searches active first.
label: Suggestion source

description: Maximum time allowed for a filesystem directory read behind suggestions. This is not a delay before suggestions appear. Minimum 1 second.
label: Directory read timeout (seconds)

description: Maximum number of visible suggestion rows. Minimum 1.
label: Maximum visible suggestions

description: Apply the visible-row limit separately to active-panel, passive-panel and history suggestions.
label: Separate suggestion limits

description: Send ordinary Delete operations to trash where supported. Explicit permanent-delete commands still delete permanently.
label: Use trash or recycle bin

description: Start operations in Queue, Background or Foreground mode. Individual operation dialogs can override it.
label: Default operation mode

description: Show the current name, full path, or source and destination paths in operation progress.
label: Progress path display

description: Maximum concurrent commands in Apply command. Zero means unlimited. The initial default is the logical CPU count.
label: Concurrent Apply commands

description: Show the copy destination and options dialog before an ordinary copy.
label: Confirm copy

description: Show the move destination and options dialog before an ordinary move.
label: Confirm move

description: Ask before deleting selected items.
label: Confirm deletion

description: Place initial keyboard focus on Cancel in deletion confirmations.
label: Initially focus Cancel for deletion

description: Ask before exiting f4.
label: Confirm exit

description: Walk subfolders instead of comparing only the two panel folders.

description: Stop recursive comparison at the maximum depth below the panel folders.

description: Maximum folder depth when recursion limiting is enabled, from 1 to 99.
label: Maximum comparison depth

description: Limit comparison to items marked in the panels.
label: Compare marked items only

description: Report files as different when modification times differ beyond enabled tolerances.
label: Compare modification times

description: Treat modification times up to two seconds apart as equal, accommodating FAT timestamp precision.
label: Allow two-second time difference

description: Ignore time differences in whole quarter hours up to 26 hours.
label: Ignore timezone offsets

description: Report files as different when their byte sizes differ.
label: Compare file sizes

description: Read and compare file contents using the selected content normalization.
label: Compare file contents

description: Enable the selected whitespace or line-ending normalization before comparing contents.

description: Normalize line endings or remove whitespace bytes before content comparison.
label: Content normalization

description: Show a message when comparison finds no differences.
label: Report equal folders

description: Set tab-stop width for newly opened editors. Viewer text rendering also uses this setting.

description: Copy the current line's leading spaces and tabs when inserting a newline.

description: Allow virtual space after the line end. Inserting text pads the gap with spaces.
label: Cursor beyond end of line

description: Apply matching indent_style, indent_size and tab_width from .editorconfig beside the opened file. Parent-directory discovery and the full standard are not implemented.

description: Enable completion in newly opened named files whose basenames match the configured masks.

label: Show cursor crosshair

description: Select no guide, a vertical guide, a horizontal guide, or both. Colorer can supply guide colors but the behavior is editor-wide.
label: Crosshair axes

description: Highlight other exact occurrences of an ordinary single-line selection of 2-256 bytes containing non-whitespace. This does not automatically highlight the cursor word.

description: Detect text encoding when opening a file in the editor.
